# Mocha Sunrise

[![Mocha “Sunny” Sunrise — 2015 character reference](https://everfreenw.com/archive/2015/media/MochaSunrise-Ref-Sheets-Final.png)](https://everfreenw.com/archive/2015/eqSm4N.html)

*Reference artwork: JohansRobot, credited by Everfree Northwest.*

Mocha Sunrise is Everfree Northwest’s upbeat pegasus mascot: an early-rising barista from **Seaddle** and longtime friend of the convention’s reporter, Front Page. She loves making friends, mountain camping, and spending time with Front Page’s family. She belongs to **Everfree Northwest’s convention-character continuity**, not a verified role in Hasbro’s *Friendship Is Magic* television episodes. [EFNW’s mascot biography](https://2021.everfreenw.com/about/characters/).

**Recognize her:** Coffee-brown coat, pink/magenta eyes, yellow-and-pink flame-like mane and tail, and an espresso-bean cutie mark radiating sunlight. The convention’s 2015 reference sheet calls her **Mocha “Sunny” Sunrise**: “Sunny” is a documented nickname, not a second identity. A [2023 ensemble mascot illustration](https://www.twibooru.org/3029525) is attributed on its artwork page to **Jesslmc16**.

**Voice and appearances:** Mocha has a credited speaking role in the convention’s 2015 animated promotional short, voiced by **Aluri**. She also appears in convention art, mascot profiles, and merchandise promotions, including the [2024 plushie campaign](https://2024.everfreenw.com/news/). No *Friendship Is Magic* season/episode or Hasbro-series voice credit was verified.

## Important moments

- **A voice on convention news — *Breaking News at Everfree NW 2015!* (2015 EFNW animated short; no season/episode).** Mocha is a voiced character alongside Front Page in the convention promotion. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zgvB7wvOK-w); her exact scene timestamp is unavailable.
- **Coffee clears the clouds — *Mocha Most of Your Day!* (2015 conbook cover art; no season/episode).** Hollulu’s winning illustration depicts a coffee-energized Mocha clearing storm clouds over Seattle—an emblem of her sunrise-and-barista personality, **not** evidence of a television scene or established weather-changing ability. [EFNW’s contest result and animation credits](https://everfreenw.com/archive/2015/e5NB7a.html); timestamp not applicable.
